name: Route two M=1 projection shapes to Humming and retain Marlin elsewhere
hypothesis: The isolated 1.347x and 1.245x Humming wins for N=1024 output and down projections can outweigh mixed-backend costs while Marlin retains the other three winning shapes.
expected_global_effect: Use Humming for 48 of 96 GPTQ projection calls per decode and Marlin for the remaining 48, without changing graph topology, weights, activations, or sampling.

preserved_dependencies: every projection consumes the same BF16 activation and emits the same logical tensor shape
the selected kernel is fixed per layer at model load and therefore remains CUDA-graph safe
attention, recurrent state, KV state, model topology, sampling, and scheduling remain stock vLLM
changed_boundaries: N=1024,K=2048 and N=1024,K=3584 checkpoint tensors are losslessly transformed into Humming's packed layout
the other three unique projection shapes retain stock Marlin packing and execution
prohibited_rewrites: no modification of GPTQ integer values or scales
no output shortlist, speculative decoding, changed sampling, or skipped work
dependency_contract.numerical_ordering: Selected layers may accumulate in a different order; the frozen exact-greedy token gate is mandatory and any mismatch rejects the candidate.

evidence.claim: Atomic screening identifies exactly two Humming-winning shapes and a 1.149x projection-weighted oracle margin.
